exposure: Presentation to hospital with DFM after 28 weeks gestation
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (neonatal intensive care unit admission, severe acidosis, 5-minute Apgar score <4, or stillbirth or neonatal death)
cohort: 101,597 singleton births without a known congenital anomaly after 28 weeks' gestation at Mater Mothers' Hospital in Brisbane, Australia, from 2009 through 2019
finding: Presenting with DFM was not associated with higher odds of stillbirth, but was associated with increased odds of SGA, composite adverse perinatal outcome, planned early term birth, induction of labor, and emergency cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women presenting with decreased fetal movement had higher odds of emergency cesarean delivery compared to women without decreased fetal movement.
